ine_delitos_dep.name: Cuadros 3.08.02.03 to 3.08.02.12: Bolivia and each department - Denuncias de delitos comunes, según tipo de delito, 2007-2024 (row "Homicidio")
ine_delitos_dep.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) Bolivia; data from Policía Boliviana
ine_delitos_dep.years: 2007-2024 (2018-2024 marked preliminary; 2024 published as n.d., kept as "n.d.")
ine_delitos_dep.notes: Reported cases (denuncias) recorded by the Policía Boliviana under "Homicidio", the Penal Code heading that may also include non-intentional forms; the source does not define it. Each file holds this table on its second sheet (the first sheet, "Hoja1", is an older national 2000-2016 table, not used). Department rows sum to the national row in all years except 2012, 2013, 2015, 2016 (e.g. 2012: departments 2,120 vs national 2,671), because the La Paz file gives 592 (2012) and 1,086 (2013) where table 3.08.02.13 gives 1,143 and 1,073. Values kept exactly as published. Note in source: 2008 records for Chuquisaca, Tarija, Santa Cruz, Beni and Pando are incomplete (records lost by the police).

ine_mayor_incidencia.name: Cuadro 3.08.02.13: Bolivia - Denuncia de casos de delitos comunes de mayor incidencia, según departamento y tipo de delito, 2007-2024 (row "Homicidio(2)")
ine_mayor_incidencia.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) Bolivia; data from Policía Boliviana
ine_mayor_incidencia.notes: Same police measure as ine_delitos_dep but a separate INE table; kept as its own measure because some values differ (La Paz 2012/2013; national 2015 1,737 vs 1,713 and 2016 674 vs 656). Department rows sum to the national row every year. Source footnote (2): from 2016 the figures refer only to homicide, not attempted homicide (implying earlier years include attempts). In this table Beni and Pando 2007-2011 repeat each other's figures for several rows (Pando 2007-2011 totals equal Beni's); kept as published.

ine_no_consumados.name: Cuadro 3.08.02.14: Bolivia - Denuncias de casos de delitos no consumados, según departamento y tipo de delito, 2007-2024 (row "Tentativa de homicidio(1)")
ine_no_consumados.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) Bolivia; data from Policía Boliviana
ine_no_consumados.notes: Attempted homicide reports. Source footnote (1): 2007-2014 the row comprises homicides, asesinatos and suicides; from 2015 it is attempted homicide only. Department rows sum to the national row every year.

ine_feminicidios.name: Cuadro 3.08.01.36: Bolivia - Feminicidios según departamento y grupo de edad, 2015-2022
ine_feminicidios.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) Bolivia; data from Policía Boliviana
ine_feminicidios.notes: Source: Policía Boliviana - Departamento de Estadística; Observatorio Boliviano de Seguridad Ciudadana y Lucha Contra las Drogas; INE. Age groups sum to each department total and departments sum to the national total in every year. 2017 and 2018 figures are identical in every cell, as published.
